description: The DL-01 RTO is the Zonal Office for the North Delhi district, located at Mall Road near Delhi University. It is one of the primary transport offices in the National Capital Territory, handling critical services like vehicle registration, driving licenses, and commercial vehicle permits for major northern residential and institutional areas.
address: Deputy Director's Zonal Office, Mall Road, Delhi - 110007

description: DL-02 is the Regional Transport Office for the New Delhi zone, headquartered at Tilak Marg. It manages vehicle registrations and driving licenses for the central and VIP areas of the capital, including iconic locations like Connaught Place and India Gate.
address: Deputy Director's Zonal Office 3, Tilak Marg, New Delhi

description: The DL-03 RTO is the South Delhi Zonal Office situated at Sheikh Sarai. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and enforcement of transport regulations within the South Delhi district, including prominent areas like Saket and Hauz Khas.
address: DDA Market, Sheikh Sarai Phase-I, Near Press Enclave Road, New Delhi

description: DL-04 is the Zonal Office for West Delhi District-I located in Janakpuri. It is one of Delhi's busiest transport offices, responsible for vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road tax collection for major residential and commercial areas in West Delhi.
address: Transport Department Office Complex, Ground Floor, Janakpuri District Centre, New Delhi

description: DL-05 is the Regional Transport Office serving the North East district of Delhi, with its primary office located at Loni Road, Shahdara. It handles vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permits for residents in the North East zone of the National Capital Territory.
address: Loni Road, Near Power House, Shahdara, Delhi - 110032

description: DL-06 is the Regional Transport Office for the Sarai Kale Khan zone in Delhi, serving as a vital hub for vehicle registration and licensing near the ISBT. It caters to prominent areas in South East and Central Delhi including Nizamuddin, Lajpat Nagar, and Ashram. The office is responsible for issuing driving licenses, road tax collection, and various transport-related permits.
address: Zonal Office, Transport Department, Sarai Kale Khan, New Delhi

division: Transport Department of NCT of Delhi
description: The DL-07 RTO is the zonal office for East Delhi District-I located at the Mayur Vihar DTC Depot. It serves as a central hub for transport services including vehicle registration, driving licenses, and permits for the eastern part of the National Capital Territory. This office manages a high volume of transport administrative tasks for the trans-Yamuna region.
address: DTC Depot, Mayur Vihar Phase I, Delhi

description: DL-08 is the North West-I Zonal Office of the Delhi Transport Department located at the DTC Depot in Wazirpur. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and permit issuance for a large portion of North West Delhi, including industrial and residential hubs. This RTO plays a crucial role in managing the heavy transport traffic associated with the Wazirpur Industrial Area.
address: Transport Department, Zonal Office North West-I, DTC Depot, Wazirpur, New Delhi

description: DL-09 is the Zonal Office for South West District-I in Delhi, primarily serving the Dwarka and Palam regions. It provides comprehensive RTO services including vehicle registration and driving licenses, and is notably responsible for specialized series like e-rickshaw registrations.
address: Transport Department, Zonal Office, Dwarka Sector 16, New Delhi, Delhi 110078

description: DL-10 is the Regional Transport Office representing the West District-II in Delhi, specifically based in Raja Garden. This office manages vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and other transport-related services for major localities like Punjabi Bagh and Rajouri Garden.
address: Regional Transport Office, Raja Garden, New Delhi - 110027
